events.title: Jimi Hendrix's Passing
events.blurb: The legendary guitarist Jimi Hendrix tragically passed away on this day in 1970, at the age of 27.

angles.name: Guitar God
angles.copy: Remembering the unparalleled talent of Jimi Hendrix, who redefined what a guitar could do. His influence is still felt in every riff.

events.title: The Beatles' 'Abbey Road' Anniversary
events.blurb: The iconic Beatles album 'Abbey Road', featuring that unforgettable zebra crossing cover, was released on this day in the UK in 1969.

angles.name: Iconic Album
angles.copy: Fifty-seven years since The Beatles gave us 'Abbey Road'. Which track is your absolute favourite from this masterpiece?

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: Happy 75th Birthday to the formidable Chrissie Hynde, lead singer and founder of The Pretenders, born on this day in 1951.

angles.name: Rock Icon
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 75th to the legendary Chrissie Hynde! Still rocking and inspiring generations. What's your top Pretenders track?

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Happy 54th Birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher, former Oasis frontman and solo artist, born on this day in 1972.

angles.name: Rock 'n' Roll Star
angles.copy: Our kid turns 54 today! Wishing Liam Gallagher a very happy birthday. What's your favourite tune from the iconic frontman?

events.title: John Lennon's 'Imagine' Album Anniversary
events.blurb: John Lennon's seminal solo album 'Imagine' was released in the UK on this day in 1971.

angles.name: Timeless Message
angles.copy: Fifty-five years since John Lennon's 'Imagine' album arrived in the UK. A powerful message that still resonates today.

events.title: First iPod Released
events.blurb: Apple unveiled the very first iPod on this day in 2001, revolutionising how we listen to music.

angles.name: Music Revolution
angles.copy: Remember when this changed everything? The first iPod was released 25 years ago today, putting '1,000 songs in your pocket'.

events.title: James Bond Day
events.blurb: Global James Bond Day is celebrated annually on October 5th, marking the anniversary of the first 007 film, 'Dr. No', which premiered in 1962.

angles.name: Shaken, Not Stirred
angles.copy: Happy James Bond Day! Raise a martini (shaken, not stirred, naturally) to 64 years of 007. Who's your favourite Bond?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Remembering John Lennon, who would have celebrated his 86th birthday on this day.

angles.name: Lennon's Legacy
angles.copy: On what would have been his 86th birthday, we celebrate the enduring legacy of John Lennon. His music and message continue to inspire.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: Happy 87th Birthday to the legendary British comedian, actor, and writer John Cleese, born on this day in 1939.

angles.name: Comedy Genius
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the iconic John Cleese! From Python to Fawlty Towers, a true master of British comedy.

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their experimental double album, commonly known as 'The White Album', on this day in 1968.

angles.name: White Album Wonder
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years since The Beatles unleashed 'The White Album'. A sprawling, diverse masterpiece – what are your hidden gems from it?

events.title: Freddie Mercury's Passing
events.blurb: Remembering the incomparable Freddie Mercury, who passed away on this day in 1991.

angles.name: Queen Forever
angles.copy: Thirty-five years since we lost the one and only Freddie Mercury. His voice, his stage presence – truly irreplaceable. What's your favourite Queen anthem?

events.title: The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles' groundbreaking album 'Rubber Soul' was released on this day in 1965.

angles.name: Pivotal Album
angles.copy: Fifty-one years of 'Rubber Soul'! The Beatles' album that marked a significant shift in their sound. What's your standout track?

events.title: John Lennon's Passing
events.blurb: Remembering John Lennon, who was tragically killed on this day in 1980 in New York City.

angles.name: Never Forgotten
angles.copy: Forty-six years since the world lost John Lennon. His music and message of peace live on.
